correctness.rationale: The SSPRK(2,2) stage formula reduces each modal multiplier to (1-br)^2+r. Orthogonality gives Vb^2-2Ub+U=0 and real solvability iff V/U<=1, both roots b>=1/2. Exact energy transfer multiplies an active maximal mode r*>1 by at least 1+r*(r*-1)/4 on every feasible step, contradicting finite conserved total energy after finitely many steps. Conversely if r*<=1 the weighted mean V/U stays <=1. The two-mode boundary and rational discriminant -108 follow exactly; the supplied standard-library verifier replayed successfully. Random tests are not used as infinite proofs.
